changes: Directly compared against the real Ledger app's Group Multi Entry code and ported its exact working mechanics — found the Ledger's write path has no read-only-role gate at all, while this app's did, which could silently block writes for the admin if that role ever mis-read even briefly
Added a dedicated ungated write path for this feature, matched the Ledger's exact debounce timing (800ms), and simplified back to its proven input-only save trigger
